⚙ Rate Settings
Unit prices · BOQ equations · Regional labour multipliers — all ex-VAT, Irish trade Q3 2026
SEAI grant values by scheme and dwelling type. Source: SEAI Domestic Energy Grant Listings, August 2026. One Stop Shop and Better Energy Homes are SEAI-published fixed tables. The Community Energy Grant has no universal published domestic table — it is project-based and competitive, so CEG starts from the One Stop Shop values and must be overridden with the rates your Project Coordinator has supplied in writing. Until CEG rates are entered here, CEG figures are labelled indicative on every Retrofit Cost Plan.
Scheme management & grant administration fee
What the provider charges the homeowner for running the project and claiming the grants. Quoted VAT-inclusive, and not subject to contractor's overhead, profit or contingency. A CEG Project Coordinator itemises this as a fixed charge plus a charge per grant measure. One Stop Shops normally quote a single all-in price with management embedded, so this defaults to nil for that route.
Fixed charge

measures
Uplift on coordinator basis

Solar PV is banded, not a flat rate: €700/kWp to 2 kWp, then €200/kWp to 4 kWp, capped at €1,800. External doors are €800 each, maximum two. Under One Stop Shop and CEG a replacement heat pump receives the system grant only — the central-heating grant and renewable-heating bonus apply to fossil-fuel conversions. Floor insulation, mechanical ventilation, air tightness, project management and the home energy assessment are on the managed-scheme menu only and are not standalone Better Energy Homes grants.

Full Cost Stack — Every BOQ Line Item
LINE ITEM COST
= (Qty × MatRate × WasteFactor)
+ (Qty × LabHrs × TradeRate × CountyMultiplier)

Σ LINE ITEMS = SECTION BASE COST

Each section is then loaded on its own:
× 1.12  CONTRACTOR'S OVERHEAD & PROFIT (12%)
× VAT   13.5% works · 9% heat pump supply & install (Finance Act 2024)
              · 0% solar PV (Revenue ruling, May 2023)
= SECTION TOTAL

  ↳ Energy Upgrade adds no contingency and no plant allowance: the plan is a
     baseline for judging quotes, and a contractor's quote carries neither.
     New Build and Refurbishment offer both under Advanced Options, off by default.
+ PROFESSIONAL FEES (Architect 10% / Structural Engineer scaled / BER €300 / BCMS 0.15%)
  ↳ Refurb: fees already itemised in Works Selector BOQ are tagged (feeType) and suppressed here to prevent double-count
= TOTAL PROJECT COST
− SEAI GRANTS (Refurb energy items and Energy Upgrade only — New Build = €0)
= NET COST TO CLIENT

Heat pumps, boilers & MVHR/MEV are sized in kW / floor-area bands, so they take a % uplift (+) or reduction (−) rather than a flat rate. 0 = default. Applies to the sized unit only (not emitters, cylinder or UFH).
